players.amendment:
## Driver input addition before your first visit
The driver supports a native held tap. Add "duration_ms":1000 to a tap operation when you choose a press-and-hold gesture; use an integer from100 to5000. For example {"op":"tap","name":"<exact visible control name>","duration_ms":1000}. It holds real mouse or touch input for that wall-clock duration. Choose actions from the public controls and your own interests. All other instructions and your own history stay as supplied.
